description: GET /logs?cursor=<opaque>. The operational logs the LOG tab polls. The cursor is opaque and belongs to whoever produced it: with a shared table it carries a sequence number from the database, without one it carries a sequence number local to the replica. A client hands back what it received and does not read inside it. `dropped` counts the lines that left the buffer between two reads, so a hole is not read as continuity.

opaque_fields.cursor: produced by the log sink; the client only echoes it back
